note: One request per construction. predict() never touches the network; an unreachable endpoint leaves the policy exactly equal to the no-hints policy (asserted offline).

spi_xfer_public.comment: receives no joint hints at all; only sequences, which is why the sequence switch exists

defects_found_and_fixed: LLM joint candidates were merged before the gates that read their count: six hints took SPI-master from 7 to 13, disabling M4 ranking and tripping the generated-family gate.  Measured -1 before the fix, +9 after.
EDA_LLM_MODEL was read by the recorder but not the client, so asking for flash silently used v4-pro.
A truncated answer reported status ok with zero hypotheses: completion_tokens == max_tokens (4096) is now reported as truncated.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: thinking tokens were billed against a budget sized for non-thinking output
defects_found_and_fixed.symptom: EDA_LLM_THINKING=1 returned completion_tokens == 8192 and zero hypotheses on 1 of 3 seeds while still reporting a response
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the enricher reserves EDA_LLM_THINKING_RESERVE (default 6144) of extra budget when thinking is on, and the audit record now carries the thinking mode so a run is self-describing
defects_found_and_fixed.outcome: truncation gone, but the larger budget then exceeded the timeout; thinking remains off by default on the measurements above

zero_regression: 7/7 bundled DUTs bit-identical at 5k local with the enricher wired in and off

thinking_ablation_5k_local.note: Same prompt, same accepted-hypothesis count when the request completes; the difference is entirely about completing. Chain-of-thought tokens are billed against max_tokens, so thinking needs both a larger budget and a longer timeout, and still does not produce more hypotheses.

thinking_on_budget_8192.reading: completion_tokens hit the cap exactly, so seed 260924 got zero hypotheses and therefore zero gain

thinking_on_budget_12288.reading: with headroom the request no longer truncates but exceeds the 45 s timeout on 2 of 3 seeds; the completing seed scored +7, worse than thinking-off's +10 on the same seed

thinking_ablation_5k_local.conclusion: Thinking stays off. It is worse on every axis measured: no more hypotheses (still 6 joint writes), lower and far more variable gain (+2.33 vs +9.33 mean, and +7 vs +10 on the one seed both configurations completed), plus two new silent failure modes - truncation and timeout.
thinking_ablation_5k_local.fail_closed_confirmed_live: The timeout seeds produced covered == the enricher-off baseline exactly (72/120, AUC 0.4967), which is the offline fail-closed property observed on the real endpoint rather than under a fake opener.
